vikas: flagging odd drift in paperbloom-30b-int3 bring-up. long narrative prompts (~48k tokens) start hallucinating repeated sentence fragments with slight token-phase shift. suspect RoPE frequency table mis-indexing after tiled packing.

jen: ah that's worrying. which deployment did you hit it on? hosted/dedicated/private? any env diffs?

vikas: reproduced on Private (VPC) with dedicated gpu profile (a100-sxm). interestingly can't repro on Hosted with same build. seems tied to `--kernel=nvfuser` path we use in private due to driver package pinned.

theo: can you paste the reproducer and a short log snippet? also which quant pipeline used? int3 packer from optimizer v0.9?

vikas: using quant pipeline `opt-qp-v0.9-int3` (experimental). run cmd:
```
./run_eval --model=paperbloom-30b-int3 --ctx=49152 --prompt=tests/long_story.txt --kv-mode=private --kernel=nvfuser --repeat=10 --kv-trace=rotable,idx
```
log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-22T20:11:02Z] rotable_access: pos=49120 freq_idx=614400 -> OK
[2026-03-22T20:11:02Z] rotable_access: pos=49121 freq_idx=614401 -> OK
[2026-03-22T20:11:03Z] rotable_access: pos=49122 freq_idx=9223372036854775807 -> WARNING: overflow sentinel
[2026-03-22T20:11:03Z] gen: "...and then she opened the box" -> "and then she opened the box and then she opened the" <-- shifted repeat
```
note the 9223372036854775807 sentinel (int64 max) which suggests a signed cast somewhere. full artifacts: s3://redwood-qa/triage/1712009999/paperbloom_int3.zip

lucy: int64 sentinel is interesting. previous int4 bug had 4294967295 (u32 wrap). int3 packer is new so maybe some signedness mismatch introduced when we compute `freq_idx = pos * freq_scale >> shift`. if shift is negative or casted wrong, it could saturate.

theo: i'll try a quick repro with `--kernel=cpu` and `--kernel=trt` to see if kernel choice matters. if only nvfuser triggers it, driver/kernel codepath likely at fault.

ops-bot: CI: long-ctx-evals/1712009999 queued. matrix: kernels=[nvfuser,trt,cpu], quant=[int3,int8], ctxs=[49152,49153,65536]. report posted to https://ci.redwood.ai/long-ctx-evals/1712009999 once done.

vikas: small micro-harness I used: repeatedly append the same 8-token anchor until you cross 49152 -> observe whether rotable index increments monotonically. harness is in artifacts under `micro_anchor_harness.sh`.

jen: good. also try running with `--kv-index-type=uint64` in debug build to see if the sentinel disappears (helps confirm overflow). plus run `--optimize=off` to disable quant packer micro-optimizations from v0.9.

theo: quick update: initial nvfuser run reproduced 3/10; trt and cpu runs 0/10. switching to uint64 for rotable index eliminated sentinel. so root cause likely cast -> signed saturate in nvfuser packer kernel when using int3 stride packing.

lucy: add action: 1) @theo open BUG-ML-4899 paperbloom-int3-rope-idx-signed-saturate and assign to eng-runtime. 2) @vikas add a regression test in longctx-smoke that runs micro_anchor_harness across kernels with quant variants. 3) stop rollout of opt-qp-v0.9-int3 to private until fix.

vikas: done. added harness + failing test to triage artifacts. also pinned private deployment to previous quant release. :lock:

jen: thanks team. let's also add a CI gate that runs uint64-index debug build for every new quant packer change so these overflows surface early. small note: this only affects >48k in our repro but better catch at PR time.

theo: Will follow up with a patch that removes the signed cast in nvfuser kernel and adds an assertion `if (freq_idx < 0) crash()` in debug. I'll post patch + benchmark impact soon.

vikas: great. leaving traces and kv dumps here again: s3://redwood-qa/triage/1712009999/kv_snapshots/ . I'll update thread after patch verification. :thumbsup:
